g.title: CMD_QSP
g.text: Coronary Microvascular Dysfunction (ANOCA / INOCA) — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
관상동맥 미세혈관 기능장애 QSP 기계론적 지도 · 71-ODE mrgsolve model · 2 myocardial layers × 14 drugs · 19 clusters
CFR = Q_hyper / Q_rest is a RATIO — the same low value arises from a raised resting DENOMINATOR (functional endotype) or a floored hyperaemic NUMERATOR (structural endotype)
Supply is bought only in diastole (DPTI), demand is spent only in systole (SPTI) — heart rate therefore enters the oxygen balance twice, with the same sign
black = flux/activation · red = inhibition or an opposing (cancelling) effect · blue = drug action · green = diagnostic read-out · purple = slow structural remodelling
